caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object with a scalloped, round basin at the bottom, colored in dark gray, resembling iron or another metal. Above the basin, there is a horizontal bar supported by two rounded feet, and the structure is flanked by two symmetrical, knob-like projections on either side. An arch rises from the middle of the bar, and at its apex, there is a sculpted, seated human figure. The background is plain, with a faint, light beige rectangular area behind the object, which stands out against the off-white of the rest of the surface. The entire object is rendered in shades of gray and black, with shading and highlights giving it a three-dimensional appearance. There is a small artist's signature or mark on the lower right area near the basin.
title: Foot Scraper
